closed_boundaries: V4 direct /api/cashu requests are rejected by the Go server before the Wednesday reverse proxy.
The private prepared-authorization reader and independent rollback anchor are mandatory construction dependencies, not enqueue input.
The concrete Rust FROST operation root is saved with the threshold authorization and carried through the queue, child argv, and executor re-verification.
limitations: The positive mint-port test is deterministic local code, not a fresh Nutshell, Comet, FIPS, browser, or four-host run.
The V4 browser wallet and bid path remain deliberately disabled: NIP-07 does not provide arbitrary Cashu Schnorr signing, and the client-held payment-key authorization API is not implemented.
The in-process authority runtime has no public listener or deployed service entrypoint.
A coherent rollback of both coordinator and same-host anchor still requires operator quarantine or an external monotonic authority.
Emergency unilateral refund authority remains disabled pending explicit acceptance of the post-locktime first-valid-mint-spend race.
Independent re-review of this repair was pending when this evidence was recorded.
